portraits.name: sverre
portraits.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: transparent medieval fantasy RPG dialogue portrait for Emberfell.
Input image 1: character IDENTITY and CLOTHING reference only, a multi-direction pixel sprite sheet. Input image 2: PAINTED PORTRAIT STYLE and framing reference only; do not copy her identity or clothing.
Create exactly ONE character portrait, NOT a sprite sheet: Sverre: adult man with warm medium-brown skin, dark brown eyes, no beard, no moustache, dark hair almost completely under a navy-blue knitted wool cap. Navy winter coat with thick cream shearling collar running across his shoulders, a rust-orange knitted scarf wrapped around his neck with ends down the front. Friendly sturdy adult features. Match the first reference's navy hat, navy coat, cream collar and burnt orange scarf precisely.
Style: match image 2's polished hand-painted semi-realistic storybook fantasy rendering, warm natural skin shading, fine cloth detail, softly painted edges but strong readable silhouette. NOT pixel art, NOT anime, NOT photoreal photography. Composition: head, both complete shoulders and upper arms, upper torso to waist, centered and facing three-quarter slightly toward viewer's right, eyes attentive. Entire hat/head/shoulder contours inside canvas with generous transparent margins on all sides; no cropped shoulder sides. Clothing naturally ends at lower torso. Single character, no props or scenery, no text, border, badge, circular frame, ground or cast shadow. Genuinely transparent alpha background. Produce a square canvas.
